sloka: कस्य स्यादीदृशो भाव आहारो देवसम्मतः ।आश्चर्यं वर्तते सौम्य श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ।। ७.७७.२० ॥
transliteration: kasya syādīdṛśo bhāva āhāro devasammataḥ ।āścaryaṁ vartate saumya śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ।। 7.77.20 ॥

translations.english: Whose nature would be such, and what kind of food is this that is approved by gods; O gentle one, this is a wonder, and I truly wish to hear about it.
